arrivalObservation.scope: Actual Unity spatial measurement after arrival, not inferred from planner completion.

userClearance.scope: Current valid tracked user XZ projected onto the actor route plane only for conservative body clearance. This is not a measured user foot position or a claim of user floor support.

sceneTargetObservation.scope: Bounded same-level floor stations near a visually grounded surface. Surface height is never a foot destination. Geometry is engine validation, not a semantic identification or proof of arrival.
